relations.reading: A useful capability-loss study must include retirements that genuinely remove redundancy as well as those that destroy value.

relations.title: Compensación de externalidades de red
relations.reading: The transfer-compensation example shows why network value may require funding the contributing node even when its local ledger understates the benefit it creates elsewhere.

relations.title: Compresión narrativa de capacidad
relations.reading: One testable link is whether the visible model receives resources and credit while the less visible capabilities on which it depends remain under-attributed.

relations.title: Ciclo exploración–explotación
relations.reading: The attribution protocol could help distinguish symbolic prestige from the budget, ownership and decision rights needed to keep an exploratory capability operational.

relations.title: Compresión narrativa de capacidad
relations.reading: Narrative compression is one possible visibility mechanism to examine when contribution and attribution diverge; it should be traced through actual resource and authority decisions.

relations.title: Compensación de externalidades de red
relations.reading: The second-order HID programme can extend the incentive question by testing how contribution recognition and withdrawal rights change feasible collective outcomes.

relations.title: Procedencia auditable
relations.reading: Authentic provenance, permission to use and contribution credit are different propositions; evidence for one should not silently decide the others.

relations.title: Compensación de externalidades de red
relations.reading: A later economic question is whether correcting attribution changes effective withdrawal and allocation rights, rather than only symbolic credit.

relations.title: Resultado upstream independiente
relations.reading: Contribution measurement should separate the reference outcome, the evaluated decision process and the credit assigned, rather than feeding the desired verdict into the measurement.

relations.title: Orden parcial de dimensiones no fungibles
relations.reading: Attribution measures should preserve their separate dimensions; improvement in one coordinate does not automatically compensate for an unmeasured or worsening coordinate elsewhere.
